jobs.title: Director, GTM AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Machine Learning, AI, Analytics & Data (MAAD) team builds the intelligence and technology that helps our go-to-market teams work faster, make better decisions, and spend more time with customers.

As the Director, GTM AI Engineering you’ll run our AI Engineering team for GTM. You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.
  • Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.
  • Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.
  • Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.
  • Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.
  • Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.
  • Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.
  • Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.
  • Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.
  • Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.
  • Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.
  • A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.
  • Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.
  • A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building AI or decisioning products for Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, or other GTM functions, ideally in a fast-growing enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience with CRM, customer data, support, and knowledge-management systems (such as Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Zendesk, and Databricks), and connecting agents to them (for example, through MCP servers or similar integrations).
  • Experience with agent SDKs and harnesses (such as Claude Code / Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar) and LLM observability tooling, eval tooling such as Braintrust or MLflow, and model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
  • Experience operating AI products at scale, including cost management, monitoring, and governance.
  • A visible habit of learning in public, such as writing, talks, open-source work, or internal “what’s new in AI” sessions.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Scaled Customer Success team ensures customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Scaled Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Finance, Renewals, Sales Engineering, Customer Education and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This position will take on a more technical approach to account management than a typical CSM, a successful candidate will be able to learn, understand, and convey the value of Samsara’s most complex products and features to our largest Mid-Market customers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn, investigate, diagnose and resolve technical issues for customers.
  • Drive business transformation by leading strategic customer engagements to deeply understand current operations and business goals, allowing for proactive workflow transformations and architecting action plans that define the metrics and timelines necessary to remove barriers and deliver business value.
  • Orchestrate product consultation workshops and value check-ins for our most complex partnerships, leading to feature and workflow change recommendations that help customers get the most out of their Samsara products.
  • Influence internal roadmaps across Product, Finance, and Support to drive mission-critical customer initiatives.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3 - 5+ years of experience in a technical customer success, account management, sales, sales engineering or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Has experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies

jobs.title: Navy Account Executive - Public Sector
jobs.description:
Unstructured is defining the standard for enterprise data transformation in the age of LLMs and generative AI. In just two years, we've raised over $65M from world-class investors, including Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital, Databricks, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and IBM.

Our open-source toolkit has been downloaded 97M+ times and is used by 90% of the Fortune 1000. We power production AI workflows across commercial and federal sectors — transforming PDFs, HTML, Word docs, images, emails, and more into AI-ready data pipelines that scale.

We're not just building tools; we're building the backbone of generative AI and the infrastructure that unlocks intelligence across industries.

About the Role

We are seeking a Strategic Navy Account Executive to drive revenue growth and adoption of our recently FedRAMP High certified software across the Department of the Navy — Navy and Marine Corps. You will be our dedicated seller in this space, owning a greenfield territory and building pipeline, partnerships, and customer wins from the ground up.

This role requires a hunter mentality, deep Navy procurement fluency, and the ability to position modern AI infrastructure solutions to both technical and mission-focused stakeholders.

What You'll Own & Drive

  • Own and execute territory and account plans to hit revenue and pipeline targets across the US Navy and Marine Corps

  • Build pipeline from scratch through proactive outbound prospecting across program managers, contracting officers, and senior acquisition stakeholders

  • Develop teaming relationships with Navy-focused primes, systems integrators, and ISVs

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder DoD sales cycles with a capture mindset

  • Partner with solutions engineering and product teams to deliver tailored, compliance-aligned solutions

  • Manage pipeline, forecasts, and CRM hygiene with discipline and accuracy

  • Represent Unstructured at key Navy and defense industry events including Sea-Air-Space, AFCEA WEST, NDIA, and PAE/PEO industry days

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years selling into DoD / Navy accounts with a proven track record of landing net-new logos

  • Full-cycle quota ownership — this is not an overlay or pre-sales role

  • Strong understanding of Navy/DoD procurement processes, contract vehicles, and budget cycles

  • Familiarity with DoD compliance frameworks: CMMC, RMF/ATO, IL levels, FedRAMP

  • Technical conversancy in AI, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure

  • Startup grit — comfortable building territory from scratch with limited support

  • Willingness to travel ~25–30% for conferences, customer meetings, and partner events

  • US citizenship required

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling AI, data infrastructure, or ETL solutions

  • Existing relationships with Navy-focused primes, SIs, or channel partners

  • Prior military service, DoD civilian experience, or time at a Navy/USMC program office

  • Experience with MEDDPICC or similar enterprise sales methodologies

Compensation

On-target earnings (OTE): $290,000 – $430,000, split 50% base / 50% commission at target. Base salary range: $145,000 – $215,000. Eligible for commission and equity.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll be surrounded by smart, kind, low-ego people who genuinely enjoy building together. We invest in our team with company offsites, best-in-tech swag, and the tools you need to do your best work, wherever you’re based.

We support you holistically, not just at work. For full-time, US-based employees, that includes:

  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Justworks, effective the 1st of the month following your start date. All medical plans include fertility coverage, plus access to One Medical, Talkspace (12 free therapy sessions a year), Kindbody, and Teladoc. If you waive medical coverage, we pay a $250/month allowance.

  • Financial: 401(k) with company match (100% of the first 3% you contribute, 50% of the next 2%), company-paid life insurance, and optional supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage. FSA and HSA options available.

  • Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building.

  • Time off: Flexible paid time off (unlimited), up to 80 hours of paid sick leave a year, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide winter break between Christmas and New Year’s.

  • Family: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, available after 6 months, plus up to 6 additional unpaid weeks.

  • Remote setup: A $500 home office stipend and a $75/month cell and internet stipend.

  • Team: Team and company offsites throughout the year.

We want you focused on building, growing, and staying energized for the long haul. If you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems & ERP
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise.

As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models.

This is a strategic and highly visible technology leadership role. You will lead major transformation initiatives including ERP modernization, billing transformation, and the evolution toward usage-based and consumption-based monetization. You will represent Corporate Systems in executive steering committees and major transformation programs, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, and other technology leaders.

You will partner closely with Product Managers across Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to combine business and product strategy with a forward-looking technical strategy. You will be expected to challenge legacy architectures and operating models, identify opportunities to simplify and automate financial processes, and determine how modern software engineering, enterprise data, automation, and AI can improve how Finance technology operates.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leaders across the organization.

You Will:

  • Own the technical strategy and long-term architecture for Smartsheet’s financial systems ecosystem across ERP, procurement, financial planning, payments, billing, tax, revenue processes, integrations, data, automation, and AI
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Financial Systems Engineering organization responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, and associated technologies
  • Serve as the senior technology leader for NetSuite and ERP, ensuring the platform and surrounding architecture remain scalable, maintainable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the long-term needs of a complex SaaS business
  • Provide technology leadership for major Finance transformation programs, including ERP reimplementation and modernization, establishing architecture, engineering standards, technical governance, delivery practices, and long-term platform direction
  • Partner with Product Managers for Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to translate product strategy and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture, investment decisions, and executable engineering plans
  • Shape the technology architecture required to support evolving SaaS monetization models, including subscription, multi-year, usage-based, consumption-based, and AI-related pricing and billing models
  • Partner across Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Corporate Systems to ensure pricing and packaging strategies can be represented reliably from quote and entitlement through provisioning, usage, billing, accounting, and revenue processes
  • Establish clear architectural boundaries and systems of record across CRM, product, billing, ERP, payments, tax, planning, and downstream data platforms, reducing ambiguity, duplication, and unnecessary coupling
  • Define the strategy for Finance systems data, including authoritative sources, data models, data contracts, quality, lineage, reconciliation, historical integrity, and reliable consumption by the enterprise data platform
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to integrate Financial Systems with the enterprise data lake and ensure Finance data is timely, trustworthy, well-defined, and usable for financial reporting, operational analytics, reconciliation, and AI
  • Drive stronger data quality and observability across Quote-to-Cash and Finance workflows, moving the organization from reactive reconciliation toward proactive detection and prevention of data integrity issues
  • Establish an AI strategy for Financial Systems Engineering, identifying practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity, financial operations, controls, testing, support, reconciliation, and employee experiences
  • Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted and agentic capabilities where appropriate, while ensuring financial integrity, security, auditability, human oversight, and appropriate controls for higher-risk processes
  • Develop a strategy for automated testing and quality engineering across the Finance technology stack, including regression testing, integration testing, data validation, reconciliation, and AI-assisted test generation and analysis
  • Establish modern engineering practices across enterprise platforms, including source control, peer review, CI/CD, environment management, automated testing, observability, documentation, release engineering, and operational readiness where supported by the underlying technologies
  • Determine appropriate boundaries between native SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, and custom software, avoiding unnecessary customization while enabling capabilities the business requires
  • Partner with Integration Engineering to ensure critical Finance and Quote-to-Cash integrations use scalable patterns, explicit contracts, appropriate observability, resilient error handling, and well-defined operational ownership
  • Own the technical health and lifecycle of the Financial Systems portfolio, proactively addressing architectural debt, platform limitations, fragile integrations, unnecessary customization, manual processes, and recurring operational problems
  • Establish architecture reviews, technical standards, engineering metrics, platform health reviews, and other mechanisms that continuously improve the maturity of Financial Systems Engineering
  • Represent Financial Systems Engineering on executive steering committees, transformation governance forums, and major program reviews, clearly communicating architecture decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and tradeoffs
  • Provide technical leadership across implementation partners and strategic vendors, ensuring system integrators and software providers operate within Smartsheet’s architecture, engineering, security, and delivery expectations rather than allowing vendors to define the long-term architecture
  • Partner with Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Tax, Revenue, and other stakeholders to understand business strategy while maintaining clear technology ownership of architecture and engineering decisions
  • Balance delivery of major transformation programs with operational reliability, roadmap commitments, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, security, controls, and long-term engineering investments
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, AI & Automation, and Corporate Systems to ensure Financial Systems operate as part of a coherent enterprise architecture
  • Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent with a combination of Finance platform expertise, software engineering capability, systems thinking, and curiosity about the future of financial technology

You Have:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across financial systems, enterprise application engineering, ERP, software engineering, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, or other technical leaders
  • Deep experience with NetSuite or comparable enterprise ERP platforms, with sufficient technical depth to lead architecture, challenge implementation decisions, and establish long-term platform strategy
  • Demonstrated experience leading a major ERP implementation, reimplementation, or transformation program from architecture and design through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution
  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, billing, payments, financial planning, accounting, and revenue-related workflows
  • Experience with financial platforms such as Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, or comparable ERP, procurement, planning, payments, billing, tax, or monetization technologies
  • Experience with SaaS billing and monetization architectures, including subscription and usage-based or consumption-based business models
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason across ERP, CRM, product, billing, payments, integrations, data platforms, APIs, automation, and financial controls as a connected architecture
  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and architecture, rather than solely managing enterprise application delivery, configuration, implementation partners, or support
  • Experience designing or evolving enterprise data architecture, including systems of record, data models, interfaces, contracts, quality, reconciliation, governance, lineage, and downstream consumption
  • Experience partnering with enterprise Data Engineering or Analytics organizations and integrating operational systems with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise data technologies
  • Experience establishing modern engineering practices within enterprise application environments, including automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, release management, documentation, and operational readiness
  • Understanding of modern AI capabilities and the ability to identify practical applications of LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation while appropriately managing financial, security, and compliance risk
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, auditability, security, data integrity, and compliance considerations associated with business-critical financial platforms
  • Experience governing system integrators and technology vendors during large transformation programs, including the ability to challenge proposed architectures and hold partners accountable for engineering quality
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and senior business leaders to combine business strategy, product strategy, and technical strategy into coherent roadmaps and investment decisions
  • Ability to operate comfortably from executive steering committee discussions to detailed architecture reviews, translating effectively between business executives, Finance leaders, Product Managers, engineers, architects, and implementation partners
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge legacy processes and architectures constructively and lead organizations through significant technology and operating-model change
  • Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with demonstrated executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technology decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$175,000—$290,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Hardware Quality
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. This is a full-stack applied data science role that combines data foundations, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and cross-functional technical leadership.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and evolve reliability and quality models for current and next-generation Oura Ring products, including warranty forecasts, runtime degradation, survival analysis, failure-mode prediction, and cohort-based field-performance analysis.
  • Develop diagnostics and root-cause analysis systems that connect ring telemetry, firmware and engineering diagnostics, manufacturing records, supplier and component data, testing results, activations, and warranty outcomes.
  • Partner with Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Battery Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Support Engineering to identify the highest-leverage reliability risks and translate them into measurable analytical problems.
  • Analyze component, supplier, manufacturing-process, and ring-build variation to identify drivers of product quality and inform corrective actions, design decisions, and supplier-quality improvements.
  • Build trusted analytical data products and pipelines that unify hardware, manufacturing, firmware, diagnostic, activation, and warranty data and make them usable for recurring analysis and decision-making.
  • Develop production AI-enhanced dashboards, monitoring, and decision-support tools that surface emerging failure risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Establish robust measurement practices for hardware quality, including metric definitions, cohorting, normalization, uncertainty, data-quality checks, and appropriate statistical methods.
  • Translate complex technical findings into concise recommendations that influence hardware roadmaps, launch decisions, quality plans, firmware priorities, warranty strategy, and member experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems and help raise the bar for data science practices through documentation, peer review, reusable tooling, and mentorship.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco.

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, reliability engineering, quality analytics, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of owning high-impact problems end to end.
  • Demonstrated experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, or advanced analytics to reliability, quality, manufacturing, hardware, IoT, electronics, automotive, medical devices, or another physical-product domain.
  • Strong experience with reliability and time-to-event methods, such as survival analysis, hazard modeling, accelerated-life testing, degradation modeling, warranty forecasting, or related techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building analytical data models, statistical or machine-learning workflows, and production-quality measurement systems.
  • Strong data-engineering intuition, including experience unifying and transforming data from multiple operational and technical systems into reliable datasets for analysis and modeling.
  • Experience working with noisy, incomplete, longitudinal, or high-volume telemetry and test data, and the judgment to distinguish data artifacts from meaningful product signals.
  • Experience designing experiments or observational analyses that support technical decisions, including an understanding of confounding, bias, uncertainty, and validation.
  • Experience with modern cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, AWS, dbt, Snowflake, or similar tools.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to engineers, quality and operations partners, product leaders, and executives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams and to drive progress when requirements and data are still evolving.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with consumer electronics, wearables, IoT, batteries, embedded systems, firmware, sensors, or connected devices.
  • Experience analyzing manufacturing, supplier, component traceability, MES, ERP, engineering test, or warranty data.
  • Experience with battery degradation, runtime modeling, charging optimization, power management, or electronics reliability.
  • Experience building field-failure analysis, anomaly detection, predictive-maintenance, or early-warning systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware development and launch processes, including EVT, DVT, PVT, and field-test programs.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family

jobs.title: Director Cloud Architecture & Delivery
jobs.description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

The Director of Cloud Architecture & Delivery builds and leads the cloud architecture and forward-deployed engineering capability that enables Energy Exemplar's Solutions (pre-sales) organization to win and launch cloud-hosted and AI-enabled customers. This role builds and leads a team that works directly with customers to design, integrate, deploy, and validate cloud solutions and AI agents in customer environments. The position sits at the intersection of four disciplines: enterprise cloud architecture (Azure-first, multi-cloud fluent), energy-market software (PLEXOS, Aurora, Adapt2, and the PLEXOS Intelligence layer), applied AI and agentic systems, and consultative pre-sales. Utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, and regulators look to the Director for how Energy Exemplar's platform and AI agents run securely and at scale alongside their own cloud estates. The role owns the technical cloud and AI deployment in every pursuit: reference architectures, security and compliance responses, proof-of-concept environments, and the delivery plan that turns commitments made during the sales process into a practical, successful cloud and AI onboarding.

The Director reports to the Vice President, Solutions (Americas) and sits within the Presales Solutions team. Partnering with Sales, Solutions, and Services, the Director shapes solutions for complex opportunities, leads technical conversations with senior customer stakeholders, and builds confidence in proposed architectures. The role works day to day with Sales and Account Directors, Solutions Engineers, Product and Engineering (PLEXOS Cloud and PLEXOS Intelligence), Post Sales Services, Customer Success, Information Security, and cloud platform partners to establish repeatable approaches to technical discovery, solution design, and validation, guide cloud migration and deployment planning, ensure a clear, practical handover into post-sales delivery, and build internal architectural expertise through coaching, enablement, and technical standards. It is a remote, United States-based Director-level position, a people-leader role that still expects individual-contributor depth, with travel of up to 30% for onsite customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry events across North America and LATAM.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a forward-deployed engineering capability that works closely with customer technical and business teams to translate priority use cases into deployed solutions.
  • Embed with customer teams, on site and in their cloud tenants, to design, integrate, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows built on PLEXOS Intelligence, including integration with customer data, enterprise systems, APIs, and Energy Exemplar products.
  • Act as the senior cloud and AI technical advisor to customers and prospects (utilities, ISOs/RTOs, IPPs, and consultancies), engaging CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and IT leaders to build confidence and resolve technical objections.
  • Partner with Sales and Pre Sales on technical deal strategy, architecture workshops, and demonstrations; scope and guide proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, from environment build and data onboarding through executive readout.
  • Define acceptance criteria with customers and validate deployed agents and solutions against the agreed success criteria (accuracy, performance, security, and human-in-the-loop controls), with evidence customers can take to their governance and risk teams.
  • Own the cloud reference architectures for PLEXOS Cloud, PLEXOS Intelligence, and adjacent AI agents and products as deployed for customers: landing zones, identity and access, networking, data residency, high-performance compute for large nodal and stochastic runs, and cost models.
  • Lead the pre-sales-to-Services handoff for cloud and AI deals: deployment plan, architecture decision record, risk register, and onboarding timeline agreed with Post Sales Services before contract signature. Develop migration roadmaps and delivery estimates with Services and Engineering, documenting assumptions, risks, and responsibilities before commitments are made, and provide architecture oversight for complex implementations so the proposed solution carries through to delivery.
  • Set guardrails for agentic deployments in regulated environments: agent identity and permissions, tool-use boundaries, evaluation harnesses, observability, and audit trails.
  • Lead cloud and AI architecture input into RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, vendor risk assessments, and proposals, coordinating specialist input and ensuring responses are accurate and achievable; lead customer discussions on SOC 2, ISO 27001, NERC CIP adjacency, FedRAMP-equivalent expectations, and CEII handling, and maintain a current response library with Information Security.
  • Establish reusable discovery frameworks, technical materials, agent templates, and deployment patterns (SaaS, customer-tenant, hybrid), including integration with customer data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, on-prem SQL) and API/automation patterns for model orchestration, plus runbooks and environment-as-code templates that make repeatable launches the default.
  • Partner with Product Engineering to turn repeatable customer implementation patterns into supported product capabilities, reusable integrations, and deployment assets.

Skills and Experience

  • 12+ years in enterprise technology, including 7+ years designing and delivering production cloud architectures for enterprise or regulated customers in large or mid-sized organizations.
  • Experience leading engineers embedded in customer implementations (forward-deployed, field engineering, or customer-embedded delivery teams), taking AI and data solutions from use case to production while managing customer expectations, scope, and handover.
  • Strong customer-facing pre-sales experience supporting complex enterprise software opportunities, including technical discovery, solution validation and RFI or RFP responses.
  • Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (Azure preferred) and working fluency across AWS and GCP: compute (VMs, Kubernetes, batch/HPC), storage, networking, identity (Entra ID, SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM), and managed data services.
  • Experience designing AI agent engineering in production, including LLM application and agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval and tool integration, evaluation and monitoring, and model governance.
  • Ability to connect architecture decisions to customer business objectives, commercial value and delivery feasibility, including cost and risk considerations.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, REST/GraphQL, APIs and data flows, alongside cloud performance, scalability, governance and cost optimization.
  • Executive presence, communication and the ability to lead architecture and risk conversations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and procurement at utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Desirable Experience

  • Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (MS, MEng, MBA) or equivalent demonstrated senior-level experience.
  • Current professional-level cloud architecture certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
  • Working knowledge of the North American power sector: ISO/RTO market structures (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), utility IRP and transmission planning cycles, and the data-governance expectations that come with CEII and market-sensitive data.
  • Direct experience with energy market simulation, production cost, capacity expansion, or resource adequacy tools (PLEXOS, Aurora, PROMOD, GridView, EnCompass, or similar), or with ETRM platforms such as Adapt2.
  • Experience migrating on-premises, compute-intensive analytical software to cloud or SaaS delivery, including customer change management and license-model transitions.
  • Experience building or scaling a pre-sales architecture capability and supporting cloud adoption across enterprise customers.

Measures of Success

  • Strong technical win rates and effective resolution of architecture and security objections in supported opportunities.
  • Proofs of concept meet agreed success criteria and help customers make informed decisions.
  • Proposed solutions are feasible, well documented and handed over clearly to delivery teams.
  • Reusable architectures and enablement improve pre-sales efficiency and technical capability.

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.

jobs.title: Principal + Staff Software Engineers
jobs.description:
Unstructured is defining the standard for enterprise data transformation in the age of LLMs and generative AI. In just two years, we've raised over $65M from world-class investors, including Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital, Databricks, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and IBM.

Our open-source toolkit has been downloaded 97M+ times and is used by 90% of the Fortune 1000. We power production AI workflows across commercial and federal sectors — transforming PDFs, HTML, Word docs, images, emails, and more into AI-ready data pipelines that scale.

We're not just building tools; we're building the backbone of generative AI and the infrastructure that unlocks intelligence across industries.

About the Role

Unstructured is looking for Staff and Principal Software Engineers to define the architectural foundation for how enterprises process and transform unstructured data for large-language-model (LLM) applications.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in deep systems work—someone who could write the book on Kubernetes, lives and breathes Python, and understands Postgres at the index and transaction-log level. You’ll own the technical direction for our core platform, guiding how data moves through every layer—from ingestion to transformation to retrieval.

You’ll partner closely with the Head of Engineering, Head of Infrastructure, and product leaders to ensure Unstructured’s systems are performant, resilient, and ready to support the next generation of AI-driven workloads.

Location(s) Preferred: San Francisco, Bay Area, San Jose, Seattle, Sacramento

What You’ll Own & Drive

  • Define and evolve the end-to-end architecture for Unstructured’s data transformation and retrieval platform.

  • Build and scale distributed systems that process massive volumes of unstructured data across diverse formats and sources.

  • Serve as the company-wide authority on Kubernetes orchestration, cluster design, performance tuning, and reliability.

  • Lead Python architecture and best practices—ensuring performance, modularity, and maintainability across services.

  • Design and optimize Postgres schemas, queries, and indexing strategies to support large-scale metadata and retrieval pipelines.

  • Mentor senior engineers through design reviews and code guidance, raising the bar for technical excellence across the org.

  • Partner with the infrastructure and product teams to translate research prototypes into production-grade systems.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and open-source tools in LLM infrastructure, retrieval, and orchestration—deciding where and how to integrate them.

What We're Looking for

  • Have 10+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on distributed systems, infrastructure, or data architecture.

  • Are a Python expert—capable of building frameworks and performance-critical services from scratch.

  • Have deep Kubernetes expertise; you can design, deploy, and debug at scale and could teach others how to productionize it securely.

  • Are fluent in Postgres—you understand query planning, partitioning, and tuning for high-throughput environments.

  • Are obsessed with clean, scalable architecture and can lead design reviews that shape how entire systems evolve.

  • Have experience in high-performance data or AI/ML systems—especially those involving retrieval pipelines, embeddings, or hybrid workloads.

  • Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where technical depth and judgment matter more than process.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or scaling LLM-powered or RAG systems in production.

  • Familiarity with open-source orchestration frameworks, vector databases, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.

  • Contributions to open-source projects in Python, Kubernetes, or distributed systems.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll be surrounded by smart, kind, low-ego people who genuinely enjoy building together. We invest in our team with company offsites, best-in-tech swag, and the tools you need to do your best work, wherever you’re based.

We support you holistically, not just at work. For full-time, US-based employees, that includes:

  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Justworks, effective the 1st of the month following your start date. All medical plans include fertility coverage, plus access to One Medical, Talkspace (12 free therapy sessions a year), Kindbody, and Teladoc. If you waive medical coverage, we pay a $250/month allowance.

  • Financial: 401(k) with company match (100% of the first 3% you contribute, 50% of the next 2%), company-paid life insurance, and optional supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage. FSA and HSA options available.

  • Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building.

  • Time off: Flexible paid time off (unlimited), up to 80 hours of paid sick leave a year, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide winter break between Christmas and New Year’s.

  • Family: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, available after 6 months, plus up to 6 additional unpaid weeks.

  • Remote setup: A $500 home office stipend and a $75/month cell and internet stipend.

  • Team: Team and company offsites throughout the year.

We want you focused on building, growing, and staying energized for the long haul. If you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to meet you.

Unstructured is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture where everyone can do their best work. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Databases - Analytics | UK | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

How we work:

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 103,958 - GBP 124,750. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Senior Decision Scientist
jobs.description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

As a Senior Decision Scientist, you will drive meaningful business outcomes by leading complex analytical initiatives and serving as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders.

What you will do:

  • Drive business impact through data-driven insights. Identify and pursue high-value opportunities to improve product adoption, customer engagement, and revenue growth using advanced analytical and statistical methods.

  • Lead experimentation and causal analysis. Design and execute rigorous A/B tests and causal inference studies to evaluate the impact of new product features, pricing strategies, and go-to-market initiatives. Champion experimental rigor across teams.

  • Influence product and business strategy. Partner with product managers, engineers, marketing leaders, and senior stakeholders to translate complex business questions into structured analytical frameworks and deliver strategic recommendations.

  • Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions. Own the full lifecycle of analytical initiatives — from identifying opportunities and building models to deploying solutions and measuring impact.

  • Default to AI-first thinking. Design analysis approaches, recommend solutions, and elevate standards and throughput across the team by leveraging AI tooling and modern analytical techniques.

  • Contribute to decision science best practices. Help define standards for experimentation, modeling, and insight delivery that raise the bar for analytical quality across the organization.

  • Mentor and elevate peers. Guide data scientists and analysts by demonstrating best practices in methodology, communication, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively. Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.

What you will need to know/have:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.

  • 5–7 years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related discipline with a track record of delivering high-impact, cross-functional insights.

  • Expertise in statistical modeling, machine learning, causal inference, and experimental design (A/B testing).

  • Deep familiarity with AI tooling (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean) to improve throughput and analytical quality.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation.

  • Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, modeling, and visualization.

  • Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran).

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, strategic narratives.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end data science initiatives from problem definition through deployment and measurement.

  • Experience in SaaS, product analytics, or EdTech environments is a plus.

  • Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work
